primitives.name: Stroke Execution
primitives.verbatim_quote: Give way!" and the men swing up from the "Ready" position and the boat is off.
primitives.assumptions: Impulse applied through oar blade generates net thrust along boat longitudinal axis.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Ineffective stroke due to misaligned oar trajectory or insufficient force application.

primitives.name: Command Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: The coxswain says,"Ready!" The eight oars go back to full reach and lie flat on the water or the oars may be buried for the stroke.
primitives.assumptions: Synchronized command execution across crew members ensures coherent propulsion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Miscommunication leads to asynchronous stroke initiation and reduced efficiency.

layer2.mapping: Coxswain commands map to synchronized actuator triggers in multi-agent control system.
